items.question: Where does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity attain its final absorption?
premises: A radiance is situated in the cavity of the throat.
This radiance reaches absorption in the brahma-aperture.
The attainment of absorption is described as a completed movement or state.
items.inference: The radiance present in the throat-cavity ultimately dissolves into absorption at the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The explicit subject of gatā is not stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
The grammatical agreement between udyotaṃ and gatā is ambiguous without broader syntactic context.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the cavity of the throat has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
